summary.text: Jil Tracy, a Republican, represents Illinois's 50th Senate District; the General Assembly lists her House service as 2006 to 2014 and her Senate service as 2016 to the present.

paragraphs.text: Before holding office, Tracy worked in private law, served as Mt. Sterling city attorney, and was an Assistant Illinois Attorney General, where she directed the office's West Central Regional Office.
She served more than 13 years on the Mt. Sterling Park District Board, according to the biography.
Tracy and her husband live in Quincy, the biography says.
